answer: Treat each agent as a vertex in a trust graph and let reputation flow only along edges backed by staked, slashable collateral. A sybil cluster can mint endless new vertices, but they connect to the honest region through few staked edges, so trust entering the cluster is capped by that thin cut. Fake identities can't spiral their scores upward by vouching for each other; every newcomer's voyage to full rights requires honest peers to risk stake on it over several epochs.
